reason: An owner-directed scientific-story audit rejected treating one norm-matched immediate-margin probe as evidence that AdamW takes an intrinsically better step. This result-blind migration makes optimizer-induced weight states the manuscript's object of study, demotes the one-step probe to a bounded diagnostic, and retains the crossed state-by-operator experiment as the decisive mechanism test.
allowed_changes: Replace the worse-first-step title and local-to-global paradox with a same-start, different-weight-states framing.
Describe the one-step mean-margin result only as a functional-specific local diagnostic that cannot rank whole trajectories.
Make the reached-state, continuation-operator, and state-by-operator interaction the three mechanism alternatives.
Remove all implementation-debugging narratives and historical exploratory outcomes from the manuscript, including its appendix; preserve them in repository provenance.
Introduce the separately declared dimension-utilization analysis with visible pending results until its complete audited outputs exist.
Refresh only the publication and completion source hashes transitively affected by the manuscript change.
Update public authorial documentation to match the same claim boundary.
scientific_invariants: No training run, checkpoint, data row, optimizer, learning rate, seed, evaluation task, metric, geometry feature, or statistical procedure changes.
The corrected all-rate and state-by-operator result macros remain at their predeclared manuscript positions.
No point estimate, interval, decision rule, conclusion branch, or mechanism estimand changes.
Historical one-step values remain available in repository evidence; they do not enter the active manuscript or rank whole optimizer trajectories.
The maximum 8-page main-text boundary and declared appendix result tables remain enforced.
runtime_transition: Because the waiting factorial ledger contains zero executed steps, archive it byte-for-byte after stopping only its own waiting controller, then restart the unchanged handoff against the refreshed source contract. The main corrected trainer, main finalizer, and sealed-checkpoint supervisor remain untouched.
claim_boundary: This migration changes the manuscript's explanatory framing before corrected retrieval and factorial outcomes exist. It does not create a positive weight-space mechanism claim: only the frozen out-of-dose bridge and crossed reset estimands may support one.
scientific_wording_clarification: Use all unordered rate-pair subspace comparisons as actually frozen; three sampled rotations do not prove arbitrary-basis invariance; the state-by-operator factorial does not directly intervene on any measured geometry feature. No numeric rule or estimand changes.
